name: @arena/expert-session-policy
description: Arena enterprise session policy packs domain core (Work Order C018; issue #124; spec/expert-environment-session.md EES1.0 privacy barrier + spec/security.md S1.0 data rights). Versioned, tenant-scoped, composable PolicyPacks over the EES1.0 control set with typed closed validation outcomes (valid / conflicting-controls-with-reasons / infeasible-for-session-modes), per-artifact-class retention schedules with typed disposition transitions (RETAIN/ANONYMIZE/DELETE_PENDING/DELETED — audit history retained after deletion), security.md data-rights metadata, explicit cross-tenant pack reuse authorization, and an append-only tamper-evident policy audit trail.
